detail:
New decision "P1 accepted as a NEW design decision: a relative TWINING_PROJECT will resolve against the declaring repo root, preferring the main checkout (root = gitRootOf(cwd) ?? cwd; base = resolveWorktreeMain(root) ?? root), shipped as a W3 warn phase (dual-base notice, identical policy in TS and all five hooks) then a W5 default flip; the neither-store-exists case is unruled (conservative default: keep cwd semantics until the flip). Supersedes the project-root.ts:15-17 header claim and #46's maintainer-note premises, NOT decision 01KY68QN70W0RRWCNMWH57WNEW (doc-placement only)" relates to:
- 01M0Y7ECSFEH1HJA1EK21PV4WG: "DD-8 (file-wins ingest precedence) evidence folded, precedence unchanged: field-confirmed record-level revert; the one-sided supersession link as its durable residue; the same-turn readback explicitly UNEXPLAINED by the mechanism and not banked; the promote-time mirror-throw window resolves by a silent reverted promote that lifecycle_reverts does not arm for"
- 01M0Y7ECTYCPQDY5TPYX3AZD83: "Per-call project parameter on twining_record/post/decide re-declined with the field's architectural argument as the primary ground (the caller must not be the authority on what it may write to; a per-call target converts a structural boundary into a convention) and store lifecycle/locking cost as secondary"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 2 existing decision(s) overlap
